title: Basic MOS Device Physics
intro: Everything in analog CMOS design starts with a handful of equations for one transistor. This chapter builds them.

blocks.text: The MOSFET is a voltage-controlled current source with imperfections. Learn the four things below and you can analyse nearly every circuit in the rest of the topic:

items: Structure and symbols: what the terminals do.
I/V characteristics: triode and saturation, and how gm arises.
Second-order effects: body effect, channel-length modulation, subthreshold conduction.
Small-signal models: gm, gmb, ro and the capacitances.

blocks.text: Reading order: MOSFET as a Device, I/V Characteristics, Second-Order Effects, MOS Device Models. The I/V page has the main simulations.
